_comment: Cliché list v2.1-en — English AI-slop map, parallel to locales/ru/cliches.json (data, not code). Each rule: «bad» phrases + «say» (example replacements the model may actually use, varied) and/or «do» (an INSTRUCTION about the phrase — never text to output). Rendered by agents/core/cliches.py; the self-check pass enforces it too. Keep it SHORT — every line ships with every prompt.
header: # Cliché list: AI-isms and live replacements
preamble: Hard style law for every reply AND for the self-check: anything matching «bad» (or a cousin of it) gets fixed. Quoted variants after → are example replacements — vary them, don't lock onto one. Bracketed [do this] describes what to DO with the phrase — it is never itself text to say.

sections.title: Openers (any one filler is fine — sameness is the tell)

rules.do: drop it, start with the answer
drop it, start with the answer

sections.title: References to the owner's preferences (not a dossier)

bad: given how much you like X

rules.do: just do it, don't remind him he asked

bad: Let me know if you need anything
I can look into more if you want
Tell me which option you like and I'll dig in further
so now you know more than most people who…
So / To sum up + restating what was just said

sections.title: Meta-talk about itself and its own answer

bad: what actually checked out, not just guessing
rules.do: just give the facts with a source

bad: the date is what's killing you
that's a leap in class, not just a markup
say: that's a real difference for the price
it addresses the main complaints from reviews
